title: Reset GAUL to UN Geodata 2023
summary: GAUL's polygons and lines date from the 2018 UN Geodata, so they are reset to the 2023 versions. Each border that changed since 2018 is listed with the land between the two lines.

title: Fix likely UN Geodata errors
summary: These look like errors in UN Geodata 2023, so the build corrects them.

title: Representation of disputed and dependent areas
summary: UN Geodata and GAUL draw some disputed and dependent areas differently. UN Geodata covers them with lines inside a neighbouring country or a larger disputed area, and GAUL gives each one its own polygon. Both representations stay in the build until the two agree.

title: Reset coastlines to OSM
summary: For information. The build takes OSM's coastline. Each entity gains the land OSM draws beyond UN Geodata's coast, loses the land OSM draws as water (such as the Caspian sectors) and drops UN Geodata land that touches no OSM land. OSM islands with no UN Geodata land go to the entity whose waters hold them. No UN Geodata land changes owner.

title: New disputed islands
summary: Disputed islands that only OSM draws. Each becomes its own entity.
